issues.title: Setup just hangs after GitHub auth
issues.author: public-user-alex
issues.body: After I approve GitHub auth, the setup just hangs after auth. There is no visible progress and I don't know if it is still working or stuck. I waited ten minutes and then killed it.

issues.title: Show which GitHub Project fields are missing before workflows fail
issues.author: public-user-mika
issues.body: The launch readiness workflow failed because my project did not have the expected fields. It would help if the app said exactly which project fields are missing before the workflow runs.

issues.title: EU payment launch needs Klarna in the readiness checklist
issues.author: public-user-camille
issues.body: For EU Payment Methods, Klarna is the payment method our beta customers keep asking about. The readiness checklist talks about cards and SEPA but not Klarna.
exact_phrases: cards and SEPA but not Klarna

issues.title: German screenshots still show English fallback text
issues.author: public-user-jonas
issues.body: In the German beta screenshots, the export screen still shows English fallback text for 'download history' and 'request export'. It makes the localization feel half done.

discussions.title: Can setup show progress steps?
discussions.author: public-user-nora
discussions.body: Setup needs a progress checklist. Right now it feels like a black box between GitHub auth and the first project sync.

discussions.title: Weekly report should say what changed since last Friday
discussions.author: public-user-sam
discussions.body: The Friday report is useful, but I want a 'what changed since last Friday' section so I do not re-read the whole thing.
exact_phrases: do not re-read the whole thing

pull_requests.title: Docs: add workaround for setup stuck after auth
pull_requests.author: public-user-lee
pull_requests.body: This PR documents a workaround for when setup gets stuck after login. The workaround is to refresh the browser and rerun project sync.
